div.div: Each run 1 Credentials: projected tokens (gateway 1 h, Vault 10 min), nothing long-lived stored · 2 Queue: fixed searches through the gateway, last 2 h, stable item keys · 3 Dedupe: skip items posted in the renotify window · 4 Triage: Claude with read-only tools + runbook, item data marked untrusted · 5 Report: Slack card unless routine; every run and item logged to Splunk
